title: Jubilant Smoky Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A funky and adventurous Syrian dish featuring smoky lamb, melted cheese, and crispy filo pastry, perfect for a special occasion. This halal-friendly recipe is sure to impress your guests.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sumac, paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the filo pastry with olive oil and cut into 1-inch squares.
Wrap each lamb skewer with a few pieces of filo pastry, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through and the filo pastry is crispy.
While the skewers are cooking, melt the akawi cheese in a small saucepan over low heat.
Serve the skewers hot with the melted cheese pulled apart and wrapped around the lamb.
